annual_stability.gate: favorable effect in every supported required year and all three required years supported

block_stability.gate: at least three supported segments, favorable effect in at least three, and no supported segment effect below -5 percentage points

cross_venue: not failed unless >=20 known GC observations and the 95% block-bootstrap upper confidence bound for median sign-normalized GC displacement is below zero
directional_symmetry: both UP-prior and DOWN-prior subgroup effects must be favorable; one-sided pooled effects cannot advance
first_event_sensitivity: earliest event per session_date and event_family; effect must be favorable and at least 50% of the complete canonical-event effect

multiplicity.primary: Benjamini-Hochberg separately by session and stage across all outcome-blind support-eligible tests
multiplicity.secondary: Holm across 5m, 30m, 60m within each test; descriptive only

outcome.anchor: close of complete XAUUSD one-minute bar ending at decision_at
outcome.availability: complete unique IC Markets MT5 XAUUSD 1m records with available_at <= close_time
outcome.endpoint: close of complete XAUUSD one-minute bar ending at decision_at+horizon
outcome.flat_binary_policy: exclude from binary hit rates; retain in continuous displacement
outcome.gc_consistency: authoritative continuous-matching uncrossed two-sided bucket states at decision_at and +15m; 0.1 USD GC tick
outcome.source_opening: one sequential source stream opening; matching rows parsed twice in memory for independent arithmetic
outcome.unknown_policy: retain identity; exclude only from the affected endpoint; never impute or drop a test from multiplicity

ranking: highest lower confidence bound on favorable hit-rate lift

stage_2.effect: condition favorable hit rate minus comparison favorable hit rate
stage_2.evaluate: only frozen SUPPORT_ELIGIBLE tests; SUPPORT_FAIL tests retain null p-values

randomization.rule: all binary event outcomes on a date flip together
